task: Review the RedCap revival implementation queue and formal usability checker plan before implementation.
user_intent: Norven wants Cap to continue after the completed 360-degree old RedCap scan: generate a complete revival plan, implement it, audit the revived project, optimize it, and stop only when RedCap can be formally used.
main_claim: After the scan merge, the next safe implementation step is to add an executable revival implementation queue plus a formal usability checker, then use that queue to close already-implemented scan conclusions and expose the remaining external-project command surface gap.
changed_reality: The 360-degree old RedCap scan account is merged and task facts mark full-360-old-redcap-scan as verified.
The scan merge contains three verified design groups: runtime/project/user boundary, development lifecycle review, and long-task context defense.

The current runtime already has boundary, lifecycle, final-claim, Prism dispatch, Prism shard, knowledge gateway, host-hook audit, soul loader, layout, task fact, human output, and temporary usable checks.
The remaining implementation plan should not reopen old no-promote mechanisms such as report-as-progress, receipt-as-completion, closeout recursion, or raw-evidence-default.
requested_review: Challenge whether adding a revival implementation queue and formal usability checker is the right next reality-changing step after the scan merge.
Challenge whether the proposed queue can honestly mark existing capabilities verified without claiming full revival too early.
Identify any required-now implementation item missing from the queue before Cap begins formal usability work.
Check whether command surface aliases such as status, diagnose, doctor, debug, summary, and revive should be added now or treated as a later external-project feature.
Check whether this plan avoids treating contracts, reports, receipts, task facts, or review outputs as completion by themselves.

evidence.summary: Merged 360 scan output with portable designs, risk designs, open questions, and evidence paths.
Continuous revival stages CR-S01 through CR-S06.
Confirmed scan_complete=true and conclusion scope allows final scan conclusions.
Confirmed current scaffold is temporarily usable.

known_constraints: Do not revive old report completion, receipt completion, closeout recursion, or raw evidence default mechanisms.
Do not claim formal usability until the formal checker passes and the implementation queue has no required open items.
Cap must evaluate Prism feedback and resolve disagreements instead of blindly accepting or vetoing it.
